semantics.visual_change: A debounced review segment based on UI-region pixel change; it is not a confirmed game action.
semantics.ring_state: A sparse colour-based position observation for review, not player tracking ground truth.
semantics.impact_or_damage_flash: A short visual candidate that needs confirmation from the video.
semantics.health_bar_change: A visual health-bar movement candidate that needs confirmation from the video.
